newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Molten Metal cut to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Molten Metal cut to buy.

text.p: -- Molten Metal Technology Inc shares were cut by Alex. Brown & Sons Inc to a buy from its prior rating of strong buy on Monday.
-- shares were in steep decline in early trading, off 11-5/8 or 41 percent to 16-1/2, a new 52-week low.
-- The Waltham, Massachussetts-company said overnight lower research and development funds from the government would hurt its third and fourth quarter earnings.
-- Analyst Cotton Swindell said he previously expected Molten to receive $12 million in the third and fourth quarters and $20 million in 1997 from the U.S. Department of Energy.
-- The funds are part of a Lockheed Martin Corp contract to test two processes for the clean-up of a tank waste site in Hanford, Washington.
-- He said the DOE's rationale for cutting the funds was that since the company does have operating facilities. He said Molten Metal has recontracted with Hanford..
